messages:
Taylor: quick syncorchid spark onboarding route. goal: a tidy 2-email welcome + 5-day webinar reminder for registrants. keep it lightweight for trial-signups and benchmark-download leads. any must-haves?
Nina: agree. segments: trial-signup, benchmark-download, webinar-reg. de-dupe: prefer most_recent_source. add 5% randomized holdout for lift.
Omar: timing: immediate welcome, day3 playbook, webinar reminder at -48h. APAC send window 10-13 JST, EU 9-11 CET, NA 9-12 PT. initial throttle 125/min, ramp 20% every 10m.
Cass: deliverability checklist: SPF/DKIM verified for rwd.ai, List-Unsubscribe header, seed addresses = product@, qa@, privacy@. exclude recent hard bounces and GDPR opt-outs.
Taylor: subject line test for Email1: A) "Orchid benchmark ready" B) "Start with your Redwood snapshot". preview text test: latency-first vs cost-first. 50/50 split per segment. measure open->click at 48h.
Nina: SQL cohort for ops:
```
SELECT id, email FROM leads
WHERE lead_source IN ('trial-signup','benchmark-download','webinar-reg')
  AND created_at >= '2026-01-01'
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND bounce_type != 'hard'
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
```
Omar: add conditional enterprise block for trial-signup (dedicated capacity CTA). backfill? yes but run separately low-rate (tag backfill=true) after main launch to avoid metric pollution.
Cass: analytics tags: utm_campaign=orchid-spark, utm_source=welcome, include hashed_user_id param. create dashboard for 24h open, 72h click, 7d demo conversion. alert if open rate < -25% vs baseline.
deliveries-bot: Campaign "orchid-spark-onboard" scheduled: start=1788127200, rate=125/min, segments=3, holdout=5%, backfill_job=queued.
Taylor: :rocket: Ben will finish copy by 11:30, Nina please run seed sends, Omar schedule backfill after main. post-launch quick sync tomorrow 9am PT to review 0-24h metrics.
